/work.description: Deliver one issue or task through verification on main.
/work.workflow: For an empty target query current GitHub issues, PRs, main and working state. Rank by capital risk, security, data integrity and structural impact. Explain any higher-ranked externally blocked item and choose the highest actionable one. For a specified target reconcile existing code and issues first. Use engineering-standard, financial-verification where applicable, kanz-verify and pr-delivery. Identify root cause, owning plane and failure conditions; implement a permanent scoped correction. Verify invariants, failure and recovery with applicable real dependencies, formatting, static analysis and regression gates. Preserve unrelated edits. Commit, push, open or update the PR, investigate failures, wait for required checks and approvals, merge when authorized and verify the merged revision before closing the issue. Report tested revision, dependencies, skips and closure state. Recommend one next issue and ask before starting it. Require explicit authorization for the specific merge; never adopt external code without approval. For a pricing task retrieve /memory before repeating discovery, and cross-check adapters and independent oracles. A receipt never satisfies fresh acceptance. For an untargeted /work use /prioritize as a shortlist only: verify actual blockers, shipped patches and duplicates before selecting.

/audit.description: Audit institutional capabilities or a domain; stop before implementation.
/audit.workflow: Default to the whole repository. Trace served code, data sources, guards, exemptions, history, tests and active issues across portfolio, quantitative risk, execution, operations, settlement, PIT replay and concurrency. Separate a library, a wired production path and observed estate evidence. Compare institutional capabilities only against attributable sources. Rank financial gaps and integrity vulnerabilities by severity, evidence and impact. Reuse or file actionable issues per AGENTS.md. Report the 2-3 largest gaps, target architecture, prioritized roadmap and one recommended task with test strategy. Ask for explicit authorization before implementing. No code or production changes.

/ci.description: Diagnose and repair a PR or workflow-run failure.
/ci.workflow: Resolve the PR/run and exact SHA. Inspect full failed-job logs, distinguish infrastructure faults from regressions and assess financial impact. Reproduce the failure, make a permanent scoped repair, add discriminating regression coverage and rerun the affected gate and required CI. Do not use a retry as proof of repair or bypass reviews. Use pr-delivery. Report exactly three bullets: Root Cause, Permanent Fix, Verification, with actual merge/main status.

/verify.description: Verify acceptance of an issue, PR or financial calculation.
/verify.workflow: Use kanz-verify and, for valuation or backtests, financial-verification. Resolve exact revisions and runnable acceptance criteria. Test affected boundaries, financial precision, failure and recovery with appropriate dependencies. Report pass, fail, skipped, unproven and blocked separately. Do not implement, merge, close issues, or activate production under this command.

/deps.description: Assess one dependency before proposing adoption.

/review.description: Review an exact diff independently of implementation.
/review.workflow: Resolve both revisions; inspect financial correctness, authorization boundaries and test coverage. Provide source-linked findings. Never approve your own change or merge.

/hunt.workflow: Use read-only repository evidence and scoped tests; do not probe production or execute hostile code. Separate confirmed, disproved and unverified hypotheses.

/ship.description: Deliver a change: PR, CI repair, authorized merge and main verification.
/ship.workflow: Resolve target as a PR, branch, issue or change in this checkout. Without a target use the current branch and its PR; on main without a unique change show open PR candidates and ask rather than selecting one. Inspect status, preserve unrelated edits, prepare or update the PR, review the diff, run applicable local checks, investigate and repair CI failures, and wait for required checks/reviews on the exact head. Merge only with specific authorization. Verify the resulting main SHA and its checks. Report PR, SHA, test evidence and blockers. Delivery here ends at verified main. Deployment needs a separately named environment, authorization and rollback plan; never modify the capital halt.

/gaps.description: Find missing repository files, verify gaps and file nonduplicate GitHub issues.
/gaps.workflow: First run python forge.py /scan-files from the repository root. For each candidate in scope reconcile its source line and target with current remote main and path history. Also inspect required files in the relevant manifests, build entrypoints and CI: a missing generated SDK, optional file or local deletion is not automatically a repo defect. Search open and closed GitHub issues by path and purpose, reuse existing issues, and file one issue per distinct confirmed unresolved cause using the repository labels and Evidence, Verified when, Blocked by and Source sections. Never file solely from a string match. Return the new or reused issue links and skipped false positives. Do not implement repairs under this action.

/scan-files.description: Print missing-file candidates without filing issues.
/scan-files.workflow: Run python forge.py /scan-files; candidates are not verified defects.

/update.description: Review and update Kanz Forge dependencies; prepare and test a dependency PR.
/update.workflow: Maintain Kanz Forge dependencies, not the installed Codex cache or unrelated trading-service dependencies. Read DEPENDENCIES.md and upstreams.json. Resolve any named dependency to a unique registry entry or documented development tool; refuse unknown or ambiguous names. Use /upstream to discover pins and check the selected registered projects (all if omitted), compare releases, patches, advisories, changed files, local overlays, compatibility, license evidence and integrity. For unpinned development tools inspect the owning CI/toolchain declaration and supported versions; report host-only tools separately, never install or globally upgrade them without authorization. Separate adopted dependencies from reference-only projects. Prepare an actionable old-to-new proposal with source, reason, risk and rollback; if already current say so. Before adopting changed external code obtain explicit approval for that pin. After approval update only reviewed files, preserve overlays, regenerate provenance digests, update pins and dependency links, run installation, discovery and applicable regression tests, and open or update a reviewable PR. Do not silently turn a reference into a dependency, merge, deploy or alter the capital halt.
